title: How To Get a Job in 7 Days (steal this)
description:
If I had to land a job in just 7 days with no experience, no connections, and no idea where to start, this is exactly the system I'd follow. It's the same 7-step plan hundreds of my students have used to go from being ignored to landing real interviews and fast job offers.

You'll follow Daniel, a candidate with limited experience, and see how he secures interviews in 7 days using this exact process.

IN THIS VIDEO:

1:38 Step 1: Craft your story
4:16 Step 2: Find hidden jobs with smarter search
8:04 Step 3: LinkedIn messages that get replies
9:41 Step 4: Apply to 3 hyper-targeted roles
10:40 Step 5: Interview prep + tracking
12:25 Daniel's 7-day result
13:09 What to do next

ABOUT ME:
I dropped out of university at 19 to build recruitment software and ATS systems used by hiring teams. For years I spoke to hundreds of hiring managers and recruiters every day, learning exactly how candidates get filtered, shortlisted, and hired from the inside. I started coaching friends through their job search using what I'd seen, then raised investment, built a software company, and hired my own team. I've seen hiring from every angle.

Today I help job seekers land offers faster using a proven 3-step system. I've coached hundreds of candidates into roles at firms like JP Morgan, Goldman Sachs, Deloitte, EY, and PwC and many more.
